- Lung opacities were noted in several instances, described as patchy peripheral opacification or wedge-shaped consolidation.
- Cardiac enlargement was characterized as borderline in one report, while others noted a normal heart size.
- Atelectasis was identified as subsegmental or focal, particularly in the right upper lobe and lingula.
- No evidence of lung lesions, pleural effusions, or fractures was found across the reviewed documents.
